methodology: Full sequence includes existing31 launcher/fullscreen/pause/results/rematch captures plus13 lifecycle captures on modern backends.
Focused -shelllifecycleonly omits standard fullscreen/rematch work and retains startup plus two added cycles.
Advanced explicitly enables HDR/deferredPBR/TAA with Extreme sampling and validates target/history readiness before/after loss.
Forced modern loss occurs in a real loaded match; requires actual device generation increment and nonblack composite.
Forge workspace and modal are opened and dismissed; no editor authoring/playtest coverage.

Boundary textures/renderbuffers/geometry/programs/lists/views/samplers/shader modules/surface count and bindgroups checked. Buffer pools/pipelines only logged; different bot workloads can raise high-water caches.
PNG screenshots inspected for world/HUD/replay presentation; animated frames are not frozen image goldens.
investigationNotes: An early harness left a Forge modal open; corrected explicit dismissal. Subsequent Vulkan reproduction with modal closed exposed actual replay camera initialization race: shell could consume global camera Changed before new replica first draw, leaving it in Roam at origin. Scene-local initialization fixes the race; lifecycle asserts first-person camera.
Early repeated-boundary assertion incorrectly treated17 additional pooled buffers as scene leakage. Pools are explicitly reported, not counted as stable-workload leak proof.

Initial Vulkan9cycle respawn run had6 unexpected black frames atcombined-case prepare frames4451–4456. Later diagnostic rerun passed. Root cause remains unresolved; later passes do not waive initial failure.
MoltenVK destruction allocation accounting is not proof that all native VRAM was reclaimed.
